data.summary:
Payments Business Analyst with 7+ years of experience, including 5 years in payments, banking, and financial services.
Skilled in gathering and analyzing business requirements, managing stakeholders, creating user stories, supporting UAT, and delivering solutions in Agile environments.
Strong knowledge of payment systems and standards, including ISO 20022, SWIFT MT/MX, CBPR+, ACH, Fedwire, SEPA, and cross-border payments.
Proven ability to bridge business and technology teams to deliver efficient and compliant payment solutions.

domain_and_functional: Exposure to AI tools for workflow optimization
all_skills: Exposure to AI tools for workflow optimization

responsibilities: Partnered with payment operations, product, and technology teams to deliver requirements documentation, stakeholder alignment, and UAT support across a multi-workstream USD clearing ISO 20022 migration spanning CHIPS, Fedwire, and SWIFT.

Performed field-level gap analysis between legacy SWIFT MT message formats and ISO 20022 MX equivalents, documenting data impacts on reconciliation workflows and straight-through processing for cross-border payment flows.

Authored business requirements for structured address compliance and exception-handling workflow changes, working with operations and client onboarding teams to identify and close data-quality gaps ahead of industry deadlines.
Supported execution of UAT business scenarios covering transaction submission, payment tracking, inquiry management, status updates, and exception workflows for CashPro platform enhancements.

Assessed CashPro client impact of ISO 20022 changes for corporate clients initiating payments via API and file-based channels, coordinating with product and technology teams on required formatting changes.
Performed business analysis across finance and operational workflows identifying process gaps, bottlenecks, and automation opportunities.
Created AS-IS and TO-BE process flows using BPMN 2.0.2 concepts for operational improvement initiatives.
Supported requirement clarification, functional documentation, workflow optimization, and stakeholder coordination activities.
Coordinated functional testing, UAT activities, data validation, and defect tracking using SQL and reporting tools.
Contributed to process governance documentation, SOP standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Managed end-to-end domestic and international payment processing operations using Citibank Citi Treasury & Trade Solutions / CitiDirect platform.
Processed high-value and bulk payment transactions including Wire Transfers, ACH Push & Pull payments, Direct Deposits, SWIFT, SEPA, and Fedwire transactions through manual maker-checker workflows.
Worked with batch payment processing using XML-based payment files aligned with ISO 20022 payment messaging standards.
Gained exposure to treasury banking operations, payment lifecycle management, cross-border payment flows, and structured financial messaging concepts.
Provided customer support for Amazon North America via calls, email, and chat for pre- and post-order queries.
Handled refunds, replacements, and order issue resolution within SLA timelines.
Managed escalations and ensured high customer satisfaction through timely and quality service.

education.institution: Indira college of Commerce and science, Pune

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
P R O F E S S I O N A L E X P E R I E N C E
Senior Associate Consultant, Infosys Limited
Pune
Apr 2024 — May 2026
Partnered with payment operations, product, and technology teams to deliver requirements documentation, stakeholder alignment, and UAT support across a multi-workstream USD clearing ISO 20022 migration spanning CHIPS, Fedwire, and SWIFT.
Performed field-level gap analysis between legacy SWIFT MT message formats and ISO 20022 MX equivalents, documenting data impacts on reconciliation workflows and straight-through processing for cross-border payment flows.
Authored business requirements for structured address compliance and
exception-handling workflow changes, working with operations and client onboarding teams to identify and close data-quality gaps ahead of industry deadlines.
Supported execution of UAT business scenarios covering transaction
submission, payment tracking, inquiry management, status updates, and exception workflows for CashPro platform enhancements.
Assessed CashPro client impact of ISO 20022 changes for corporate clients initiating payments via API and file-based channels, coordinating with product and technology teams on required formatting changes.
Finance Program & Operations Analyst, Accenture
Bengaluru
Jun 2022 — Apr 2024
Performed business analysis across finance and operational workflows identifying process gaps, bottlenecks, and automation opportunities. • Created AS-IS and TO-BE process flows using BPMN 2.0.2 concepts for operational improvement initiatives.
Supported requirement clarification, functional documentation, workflow
optimization, and stakeholder coordination activities.
Coordinated functional testing, UAT activities, data validation, and defect
tracking using SQL and reporting tools.
• Contributed to process governance documentation, SOP standardization, and
continuous improvement initiatives.
Process Analyst, Gallagher Service Center
May 2019 — Feb 2022
Managed end-to-end domestic and international payment processing
operations using Citibank Citi Treasury & Trade Solutions / CitiDirect platform.
Processed high-value and bulk payment transactions including Wire Transfers,
ACH Push & Pull payments, Direct Deposits, SWIFT, SEPA, and Fedwire transactions through manual maker-checker workflows.
Worked with batch payment processing using XML-based payment files
aligned with ISO 20022 payment messaging standards.
Gained exposure to treasury banking operations, payment lifecycle management, cross-border payment flows, and structured financial messaging concepts.
Customer Service Advisor, Concentrix Daksh
Jul 2017 — Apr 2018
Provided customer support for Amazon North America via calls, email, and chat
for pre- and post-order queries.
Handled refunds, replacements, and order issue resolution within SLA
timelines.
Managed escalations and ensured high customer satisfaction through timely
and quality service.

Senior Associate Consultant, Infosys Limited
Pune
Apr 2024 — May 2026

Supported execution of UAT business scenarios covering transaction
submission, payment tracking, inquiry management, status updates, and exception workflows for CashPro platform enhancements.
Assessed CashPro client impact of ISO 20022 changes for corporate clients initiating payments via API and file-based channels, coordinating with product and technology teams on required formatting changes.

Bengaluru
Jun 2022 — Apr 2024

optimization, and stakeholder coordination activities.
Coordinated functional testing, UAT activities, data validation, and defect
tracking using SQL and reporting tools.
• Contributed to process governance documentation, SOP standardization, and
continuous improvement initiatives.
Process Analyst, Gallagher Service Center
May 2019 — Feb 2022
Managed end-to-end domestic and international payment processing
operations using Citibank Citi Treasury & Trade Solutions / CitiDirect platform.
Processed high-value and bulk payment transactions including Wire Transfers,

Worked with batch payment processing using XML-based payment files
